in_sanskrit.name: Chavvi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Grace, Beauty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chavvi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chavvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chavya', which means grace and beauty. In Hindu mythology, Chavvi is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who embodies wisdom, knowledge, and art.
